verdicts.decision_note: The client confirms that the integrated board requires an external e-paper display backlight.
The series-resistor identity and its electrical ratings remain materially unresolved for the backlight circuit.

The client specifies the backlight switch, PWM control, boot pull-down, supply jumpers, decoupling, resistor population, diode omission, and load-current acceptance condition; no prior value key becomes obsolete.
The client's complete electrical specification resolves the material backlight-circuit uncertainty and returns the requirement to active implementation.
